development_context: V12 is independent and designed after V11 failed. V11 parameters and results are not modified.

target.definition: 20-day stock return minus same-date broad-sector official-weight benchmark minus fixed round-trip cost minus liquidity impact proxy

validation.global_gate: positive estimated net marginal payoff in both immediately preceding validation years
validation.technology_gate: positive technology Top5 estimated net marginal payoff in both years with sufficient samples

risk_budget.rule: full exposure when observable 60-day benchmark momentum is nonnegative; otherwise clip(target volatility / observable 60-day benchmark volatility)

replacement_gates.future_shadow: must pass after every retrospective gate

decision_policy: No parameter changes after lock. Keep V6 unless all retrospective and append-only future-shadow gates pass.
